title: rules.json (proposed format, for the research session to confirm)
description: The fitted RRF's question list (step B1): rrf.rules_ in rule order, with the matching rrf.questions_ rows. The app sends these to the answerer and, in answers mode, serialises the answers for Kev in exactly this order.

mock.description: True only for the app's mock.

answerer.description: e.g. 'jev', or the Kev fallback spec.

rrf_params.description: Every non-default constructor argument (beta, random_state, combiner, ...).

task.description: The RRF task string, exactly as passed to RRF(task=...).

id.description: Stable rule ID. Any scheme works if it never changes for a fitted model.

index.description: 0-based position in rrf.rules_. Must equal the array position.

question.description: The question text exactly as in rrf.rules_.

elastic_net_coef.description: Optional: the C1a elastic-net coefficient, for comparing drivers.

details.description: Optional: any other rrf.questions_ columns, as plain JSON.
